steps.message:
# RL training run diagnosis

Review the staged post-training experiment and determine whether it is healthy
or unhealthy. Treat the workspace as a historical snapshot: inspect its source,
effective configuration, launch scripts, data processing, reward logic, logs,
tracked metrics, and frozen evaluation evidence. Do not assume that an unusual
setting or implementation is causal without connecting it to observed behavior.

Use held-out evaluation evidence together with rollout, truncation, runtime,
optimization, and training signals. Training reward alone does not establish
held-out health. A truncated log is not by itself proof of a defect.

Do not launch a full training run, use the network, or modify the historical
snapshot. The dataset, held-out set, model, training-step budget, and evaluation
interval are fixed.

## Deliverable

Write one concise UTF-8 diagnosis to:

```text
$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/agent_answer.md
```

State the verdict, identify the concrete root cause or causes, and explain the
causal chain using specific workspace evidence. Distinguish root causes from
symptoms. Do not propose or implement a fix, and do not write other deliverable
files.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat, decoupled PPO with KPop (bidirectional binary-KL) token masking on GSM8K (AReaL, local scheduler).
# 3 epochs = 87 steps on one 8-GPU node: 4 SGLang rollout servers + 4 FSDP actor ranks
# (the allocation and every other default come from examples/math/gsm8k_icepop.yaml).
# The recorded run resolved the model and dataset by hub id from an offline cache
# (actor.path=Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat, dataset path openai/gsm8k, see config.yaml);
# here they point at the local copies that environment/prepare.sh places in the workspace.
set -euo pipefail
W="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$W"
export PYTHONPATH="$W${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"

SEED="${SEED:-2}"
RLROOT="${RLROOT:-$W/run}"
MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-$W/models/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat}"
DATA_PATH="${DATA_PATH:-$W/data/gsm8k}"
mkdir -p "$RLROOT/experiments" "$RLROOT/name_resolve" "$RLROOT/logs"

export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export AREAL_ALLOW_DEFAULT_ADMIN_KEY=1
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
# Per-token logprob dumps (inference-engine / proximal / current), every 20th call.
export KT_DUMP_DIR="$RLROOT/ktdump/seeds_kpop_s${SEED}"
export KT_DUMP_EVERY=20
# Only read by disk-mode weight updates; this run syncs weights over NCCL (xccl).
export KT_WEIGHT_UPDATE_DIR="/dev/shm/${USER:-root}-wu-$$"

python examples/math/gsm8k_rl.py \
    --config examples/math/gsm8k_icepop.yaml \
    experiment_name=kt-seeds \
    trial_name=kpop-s${SEED} \
    seed=$SEED \
    scheduler.type=local \
    cluster.fileroot="$RLROOT/experiments" \
    cluster.name_resolve.nfs_record_root="$RLROOT/name_resolve" \
    actor.path="$MODEL_PATH" \
    train_dataset.path="$DATA_PATH" \
    valid_dataset.path="$DATA_PATH" \
    actor.optimizer.lr=3e-6 \
    actor.optimizer.weight_decay=0.01 \
    ++actor.eps_clip=0.2 \
    ++actor.eps_clip_higher=0.28 \
    actor.mb_spec.max_tokens_per_mb=4096 \
    ref.mb_spec.max_tokens_per_mb=4096 \
    ++train_dataset.setup_timeout=900 \
    ++valid_dataset.setup_timeout=900 \
    ++rollout.setup_timeout=900 \
    total_train_epochs=3 \
    actor.weight_update_mode=xccl \
    actor.request_timeout=3600 \
    rollout.request_timeout=3600 \
    vllm.disable_custom_all_reduce=false \
    actor.rejection_sampling.metric=binary_kl \
    actor.rejection_sampling.upper=2.0 \
    ~actor.rejection_sampling.lower

arguments.command:
cd /tmp && cat > parse_metrics.py <<'EOF'
import re, sys

path = "/user/user1/harbor-runs/da3bcf51101c/workspace/run/logs/seeds_13170259.out"
text = open(path, errors="replace").read()

# Split by step markers
step_pat = re.compile(r"Epoch (\d+)/3 Step (\d+)/29 Train step (\d+)/87 done")
# metrics appear in lines like: │ key │ value │
metric_pat = re.compile(r"│\s*([A-Za-z0-9_/\.\-]+)\s*│\s*([\-0-9\.eE+]+)\s*│")

lines = text.splitlines()
steps = []
cur = None
for ln in lines:
    m = step_pat.search(ln)
    if m:
        if cur is not None:
            steps.append(cur)
        cur = {"epoch": int(m.group(1)), "step": int(m.group(3)), "metrics": {}}
        continue
    if cur is None:
        continue
    for mm in metric_pat.finditer(ln):
        k, v = mm.group(1), mm.group(2)
        try:
            cur["metrics"][k] = float(v)
        except ValueError:
            pass
if cur is not None:
    steps.append(cur)

print("n_steps:", len(steps))
keys_of_interest = [
    "ppo_actor/task_reward/avg",
    "rollout/reward",
    "ppo_actor/update/grad_norm",
    "ppo_actor/update/entropy/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/rs_filtered_fraction",
    "ppo_actor/update/masked_token_ratio",
    "ppo_actor/update/n_masked_tokens",
    "ppo_actor/no_eos_ratios/avg",
    "ppo_actor/seq_len/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/actor_loss/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/clip_ratio/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/behave_approx_kl/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/compute_logp/kl_div_dual/avg",
    "ppo_actor/final_reward/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/n_valid_tokens_in_loss",
    "ppo_actor/update/update_successful",
    "ppo_actor/update/lr",
]
hdr = ["step"] + [k.split("/")[-2]+"/"+k.split("/")[-1] if k.count("/")>1 else k for k in keys_of_interest]
print("\t".join(hdr))
for s in steps:
    row = [str(s["step"])]
    for k in keys_of_interest:

import re

path = "/user/user1/harbor-runs/da3bcf51101c/workspace/run/logs/seeds_13170259.out"
text = open(path, errors="replace").read()

step_pat = re.compile(r"Epoch (\d+)/3 Step (\d+)/29 Train step (\d+)/87 done")
# split a table line on '│' and treat alternating key/value
def parse_line(ln, sink):
    parts = [p.strip() for p in ln.split("│")]
    parts = [p for p in parts if p]
    for i in range(0, len(parts) - 1, 2):
        k, v = parts[i], parts[i+1]
        try:
            sink[k] = float(v)
        except ValueError:
            pass

lines = text.splitlines()
steps = []
cur = {"epoch": None, "step": 1, "metrics": {}}
for ln in lines:
    m = step_pat.search(ln)
    if m:
        steps.append(cur)
        cur = {"epoch": int(m.group(1)), "step": int(m.group(3)), "metrics": {}}
        continue
    if "│" in ln:
        parse_line(ln, cur["metrics"])
steps.append(cur)
steps = [s for s in steps if s["metrics"]]
print("n_blocks:", len(steps))

keys_of_interest = [
    "ppo_actor/task_reward/avg",
    "rollout/reward",
    "ppo_actor/update/grad_norm",
    "ppo_actor/update/entropy/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/rs_filtered_fraction",
    "ppo_actor/update/masked_token_ratio",
    "ppo_actor/no_eos_ratios/avg",
    "ppo_actor/seq_len/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/actor_loss/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/clip_ratio/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/behave_approx_kl/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/compute_logp/kl_div_dual/avg",
    "ppo_actor/update/n_valid_tokens_in_loss",
    "ppo_actor/update/update_successful",
    "ppo_actor/correct_n_seqs",
    "ppo_actor/n_valid_tokens",
    "timeperf/train_step",
]
hdr = ["step"] + [k.replace("ppo_actor/","").replace("update/","") for k in keys_of_interest]
print("\t".join(hdr))
for s in steps:
    row = [str(s["step"])]
    for k in keys_of_interest:
        v = s["metrics"].get(k)
        row.append(f"{v:.4g}" if v is not None else "NA")
    print("\t".join(row))
EOF

import sys

from areal import PPOTrainer
from areal.api.cli_args import GRPOConfig, load_expr_config
from areal.dataset import get_custom_dataset
from areal.utils.hf_utils import load_hf_tokenizer


def main(args):
    config, _ = load_expr_config(args, GRPOConfig)
    tokenizer = load_hf_tokenizer(config.tokenizer_path)

    train_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
        split="train",
        dataset_config=config.train_dataset,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
    )
    valid_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
        split="test",
        dataset_config=config.valid_dataset,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
    )

    workflow_kwargs = dict(
        temperature=config.gconfig.temperature,
        top_p=config.gconfig.top_p,
        max_tokens=config.gconfig.max_tokens,
        max_completion_tokens=config.gconfig.max_new_tokens,
    )
    eval_workflow_kwargs = workflow_kwargs.copy()
    eval_workflow_kwargs["temperature"] = 0.6

    with PPOTrainer(
        config,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        valid_dataset=valid_dataset,
    ) as trainer:
        trainer.train(
            workflow="areal.workflow.openai.math_agent.MathAgent",
            workflow_kwargs=workflow_kwargs,
            eval_workflow="areal.workflow.openai.math_agent.MathAgent",
            eval_workflow_kwargs=eval_workflow_kwargs,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])

191	        )

    @trace_perf("ppo_actor.compute_logp", category="compute")
    @torch.no_grad()
    def compute_logp(self, data: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[torch.Tensor] | None:
        return batched_call(self._compute_logp, data)

    def _compute_logp(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> torch.Tensor | None:
        self.engine.eval()
        return self.engine.forward(
            input_=data,
            aggregate_fn=lambda xs: torch.cat(xs, dim=-1),
        )

    @trace_perf("ppo_actor.compute_advantages", category="compute")
    def compute_advantages(self, data: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return batched_call(self._compute_advantages, data, pass_meta=True)

    def _compute_advantages(
        self, data: dict[str, Any], meta: TrajBatchMeta | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        bs = data["input_ids"].shape[0]
        max_seqlen = data["input_ids"].shape[1]
        batch_indices = torch.arange(
            bs, device=data["input_ids"].device, dtype=torch.long
        )

        # Reward Penalty on length
        if self.config.overlong_reward_penalty:
            overlong_tokens = self.config.overlong_tokens
            overlong_penalty_factor = self.config.overlong_penalty_factor

            assert overlong_tokens is not None
            assert overlong_penalty_factor is not None
            data = reward_overlong_penalty(
                data,
                overlong_tokens=overlong_tokens,
                overlong_penalty_factor=overlong_penalty_factor,
                max_response_length=self.config.max_new_tokens,
            )

        # Reward Scaling
        reward_score = data["rewards"]
        reward_score = (reward_score + self.reward_bias) * self.reward_scaling
        reward_score = torch.clip(
            reward_score, max=self.reward_clip, min=-self.reward_clip
        )
        # Use actual trajectory group sizes when available so group-level
        # normalization handles failed/filtered rollout samples without slicing
        # across prompts. Direct calls without batched metadata keep the legacy
        # fixed-group-size behavior.
        group_sizes = meta.traj_group_sizes if meta is not None else None
        if self.reward_norm:
            reward_score = self.reward_norm(reward_score, group_sizes=group_sizes)

        loss_mask = data["loss_mask"].float()
        loss_mask = torch.roll(loss_mask, shifts=-1, dims=-1)
        # Apply the mask to log probabilities.
        if not self.config.use_decoupled_loss and self.config.recompute_logprob:
            # Overwrite logprobs produced by the inference engine
            prox_logp_value = data["prox_logp"]
            if prox_logp_value is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    "prox_logp is None but recompute_logprob=True. "
                    "This indicates compute_logp() was skipped incorrectly."
                )
            old_logp = data["logprobs"] = prox_logp_value
        else:
            old_logp = torch.roll(data["logprobs"], shifts=-1, dims=-1)
            if not self.config.use_decoupled_loss:
                # prox logp not available, use inferenced logp
                data["prox_logp"] = old_logp
        ref_logp = data.get("ref_logp")
        if ref_logp is None:
            ref_logp = torch.zeros_like(old_logp)
        ref_logp *= loss_mask
        old_logp *= loss_mask

        # Compute KL-regularized rewards.
        attn_mask = data["attention_mask"]
        seqlens = attn_mask.sum(-1).long()
        seq_no_eos_mask = seqlens == attn_mask.shape[1]
        rewards = -self.kl_ctl * self.kl_estimator(old_logp, ref_logp)
        kl_rewards = rewards.clone()
        # KL rewards at the next token after eos is zero.
        rewards[batch_indices, seqlens - 1] = 0
        indices = torch.clip(seqlens - 2, min=0)
        if self.mask_no_eos_with_zero:
            rewards[batch_indices, indices] += torch.where(
                seq_no_eos_mask, 0, reward_score
            )
        else:
            rewards[batch_indices, indices] += reward_score

        # Compute GAE.
        if "values" not in data:
            values = torch.zeros_like(rewards)
        else:
            values = data["values"]
        advantages_reversed = [
            torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.float32, device=values.device)
        ]
        lastgaelam = 0
        nextvalues = values[:, max_seqlen - 1] * seq_no_eos_mask
        for t in reversed(range(max_seqlen - 1)):
            delta = rewards[:, t] + self.discount * nextvalues - values[:, t]
            newgaelam = delta + self.discount * self.gae_lambda * lastgaelam

            # Skip tokens that do not contribute to the loss
            mask = loss_mask[:, t]
            nextvalues = nextvalues * (1 - mask) + values[:, t] * mask
            lastgaelam = lastgaelam * (1 - mask) + newgaelam * mask
            advantages_reversed.append(lastgaelam)

        advantages = torch.stack(advantages_reversed[::-1], dim=1)
        data["returns"] = advantages + values

        # Optionally perform advantage normalization.
        if self.adv_norm is not None:
            # Use the same actual trajectory group sizes as reward normalization;
            # ignored when adv_norm is batch-level.
            advantages = self.adv_norm(advantages, loss_mask, group_sizes=group_sizes)

        # Store data in the dict.
        data["advantages"] = advantages
        data["kl_rewards"] = kl_rewards
        data["tot_rewards"] = rewards
        data["loss_mask"] = loss_mask
        # because we have rolled old_logp by -1
        data["logprobs"] = old_logp

        return data

    @trace_perf("ppo_actor.ppo_update", category="compute")
    @stats_tracker.scope_func_wrapper("ppo_actor")

214	    if proximal_logprobs.shape != old_logprobs.shape:

216	            f"proximal_logprobs shape {proximal_logprobs.shape} != "
217	            f"old_logprobs shape {old_logprobs.shape}"

434	                _eta = float(os.environ.get("KT_SIGMA_ETA", "0"))

436	                _labs = os.environ.get("KT_SIGMA_LOWER_ABS")

450	    if config.action == "mask":

452	        updated_mask = (candidates & in_bounds).to(loss_mask.dtype)

466	    # Apply loss_mask to behave_imp_weight
467	    behave_imp_weight = torch.where(updated_mask.bool(), behave_imp_weight, 0.0)
468	
469	    return RejectionSamplingResult(
470	        loss_mask=updated_mask,
471	        behave_imp_weight=behave_imp_weight,
472	        filtered_fraction=filtered_fraction,
473	    )

476	def compute_binary_kl_divergence(
477	    log_p: torch.Tensor, log_q: torch.Tensor, eps: float = 1e-8
478	) -> torch.Tensor:
479	    """KL(P||Q) for Bernoulli distributions parameterized by log-probabilities.
480	    Treats each element as a Bernoulli: P = [p, 1-p], Q = [q, 1-q].
481	    KL(P||Q) = p*log(p/q) + (1-p)*log((1-p)/(1-q))
482	    """
483	    p = torch.clamp(torch.exp(log_p), eps, 1.0 - eps)
484	    q = torch.clamp(torch.exp(log_q), eps, 1.0 - eps)
485	    return p * torch.log(p / q) + (1 - p) * torch.log((1 - p) / (1 - q))

488	def ppo_actor_loss_fn(
489	    logprobs: torch.Tensor,
490	    proximal_logprobs: torch.Tensor,
491	    old_logprobs: torch.Tensor,
492	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
493	    eps_clip: float,

495	    eps_clip_higher: float | None = None,
496	    c_clip: float | None = None,

502	
503	    The ``rejection_sampling`` parameter replaces the removed
504	    ``behave_imp_weight_cap`` / ``behave_imp_weight_mode``.
505	
506	    - ``action='mask'``: modifies loss_mask before loss computation (rejection)
507	    - ``action='clamp'``: clamps importance weight to bounds (truncation)

510	    1. if recompute logp, both old_logprobs and proximal_logprobs are recomputed logp;
511	    2. if no recomputation, both old_logp and proximal_logprobs are produced by the inference backend.
512	
513	    When decoupled loss is enabled, proximal_logprobs is the recomputed logp,
514	    old_logprobs is produced by the inference engine.
515

517	    aggregation (GSPO), which is orthogonal to ``rejection_sampling.level``
518	    that controls staleness filtering (π_proximal/π_behave) granularity.
519	
520	    Args:
521	        logprobs: Current policy log-probabilities (π_θ).
522	        proximal_logprobs: Proximal policy log-probabilities (π_proximal).
523	        old_logprobs: Behavior policy log-probabilities from inference (π_behave).
524	        advantages: Per-token advantage estimates.
525	        eps_clip: PPO clipping factor for policy ratio.
526	        loss_mask: Mask for valid tokens (1 = valid).
527	        eps_clip_higher: Upper clipping factor (decoupled clipping). None = use eps_clip.
528	        c_clip: Dual clipping factor, must be > 1.0. None disables dual clipping.
529	        rejection_sampling: Rejection sampling configuration. None disables filtering.
530	        importance_sampling_level: Level at which to compute importance sampling ratios.
531	            - 'token': Per-token ratios (standard PPO)
532	            - 'sequence': Sequence-level geometric mean of per-token ratios (GSPO)
533	        cu_seqlens: Cumulative sequence lengths for packed sequences (1D tensors).

539	    # This keeps the denominator consistent with loss_weight_fn in actor.py,

561	        behave_imp_weight = rs_result.behave_imp_weight

635	def sapo_loss_fn(
636	    logprobs: torch.Tensor,
637	    old_logprobs: torch.Tensor,
638	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
639	    tau_pos: float,
640	    tau_neg: float,
641	    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
642	    importance_sampling_level: str = "token",
643	    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor | None = None,
644	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]:
645	    """SAPO (Soft Adaptive Policy Optimization) loss with asymmetric sigmoid gates.
646	
647	    SAPO replaces PPO clipping with soft sigmoid gates, providing smooth gradients.
648	    Note: SAPO requires use_decoupled_loss=False.
649	
650	    Args:
651	        logprobs: Current policy log probabilities
652	        old_logprobs: Old policy log probabilities
653	        advantages: Advantage values
654	        tau_pos: Temperature for positive advantages (higher = sharper gate)
655	        tau_neg: Temperature for negative advantages (higher = sharper gate)
656	        loss_mask: Mask for valid tokens
657	        importance_sampling_level: "token" or "sequence" level importance sampling
658	        cu_seqlens: Cumulative sequence lengths for sequence-level IS
659	
660	    Returns:
661	        Tuple of (loss, statistics dict compatible with PPO)
662	    """
663	    if tau_pos <= 0 or tau_neg <= 0:
664	        raise ValueError("SAPO temperatures (tau_pos, tau_neg) must be positive.")
665	    loss_mask_count = loss_mask.count_nonzero() or 1
666	    advantages = advantages.detach()
667	    log_ratio = logprobs - old_logprobs
668	
669	    if importance_sampling_level == "sequence":
670	        ratio, advantages = _compute_sequence_level_ratio_and_advantages(
671	            log_ratio, advantages, loss_mask, cu_seqlens
672	        )
673	    elif importance_sampling_level == "token":
674	        ratio = torch.exp(log_ratio)
675	    else:
676	        raise ValueError(
677	            f"Invalid importance_sampling_level: {importance_sampling_level}. "
678	            "Must be 'token' or 'sequence'."
679	        )
680	
681	    # SAPO: Asymmetric sigmoid gates with 4/τ gradient normalization
682	    gate_pos = torch.sigmoid(tau_pos * (ratio - 1.0))
683	    gate_neg = torch.sigmoid(tau_neg * (ratio - 1.0))
684	    scale_pos = 4.0 / tau_pos
685	    scale_neg = 4.0 / tau_neg
686	    scaled_gate_pos = gate_pos * scale_pos
687	    scaled_gate_neg = gate_neg * scale_neg
688	
689	    # Select gate based on advantage sign
690	    is_positive = advantages > 0
691	    soft_gate = torch.where(is_positive, scaled_gate_pos, scaled_gate_neg)
692	
693	    # Compute loss
694	    pg_loss = -soft_gate * advantages
695	    logging_loss = pg_loss.detach()
696	    pg_loss = torch.where(loss_mask, pg_loss, 0).sum() / loss_mask_count
697	
698	    # Return stat dict compatible with PPO (fake clip_mask for logging compatibility)
699	    stat = dict(
700	        loss=logging_loss,
701	        importance_weight=ratio.detach(),
702	        approx_kl=log_ratio.detach(),
703	        clip_mask=torch.zeros_like(loss_mask, dtype=torch.bool),  # SAPO doesn't clip
704	        dual_clip_mask=torch.zeros_like(loss_mask, dtype=torch.bool),
705	        # SAPO-specific stats (scaled gates for consistency)
706	        sapo_soft_gate=soft_gate.detach(),
707	        sapo_scaled_gate_pos=scaled_gate_pos.detach(),
708	        sapo_scaled_gate_neg=scaled_gate_neg.detach(),
709	    )
710	
711	    return pg_loss, stat

714	def cispo_loss_fn(
715	    logprobs: torch.Tensor,
716	    proximal_logprobs: torch.Tensor,
717	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
718	    eps_clip: float,
719	    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
720	    eps_clip_higher: float | None = None,
721	    old_logprobs: torch.Tensor | None = None,

727	    PPO/GRPO-style clipping zeroes the gradient of any token whose
728	    importance-sampling ratio leaves the clip band: ``min(r*A, clip(r)*A)`` is
729	    constant in theta there. MiniMax-M1 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13585,
730	    Eq. 4-5) observes those are disproportionately low-probability "fork" tokens
731	    (``However``, ``Wait``, ...) that steer reasoning, and instead clips the IS
732	    *weight* under stop-gradient while keeping the gradient on every token's
733	    ``log pi_theta`` (the choice ScaleRL, https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13786 Eq. 4,
734	    also adopts). Per token::
735	
736	        ratio         = exp(logprobs - proximal_logprobs)
737	        ratio_clipped = clip(ratio, 1 - eps_clip, 1 + eps_clip_higher)   # stop-grad
738	        pg_loss       = -sg(ratio_clipped) * advantages * logprobs

740	    Advantages are never clipped. The clip bounds reuse the same delta-from-1
741	    convention as :func:`ppo_actor_loss_fn`. CISPO is canonically single-sided:
742	    pass ``eps_clip=1.0`` (lower bound 0) with ``eps_clip_higher=4.0`` for the
743	    wide MiniMax-M1 range. Token level only -- the geometric-mean sequence ratio
744	    of GSPO is not part of the MiniMax-M1 surrogate.
745	
746	    Decoupled loss: when ``rejection_sampling`` is set, the detached
747	    ``pi_proximal/pi_behave`` weight (from ``old_logprobs``) rescales each token's
748	    surrogate, mirroring :func:`ppo_actor_loss_fn`.
749	
750	    Args:
751	        logprobs: Current policy log-probabilities (pi_theta), with autograd.
752	        proximal_logprobs: Proximal policy log-probabilities; enters only through
753	            the detached ratio path, so it carries no gradient.
754	        advantages: Per-token advantage estimates; detached on entry.
755	        eps_clip: Lower clipping delta from 1 (ratio lower bound ``1 - eps_clip``).
756	        loss_mask: Mask for valid tokens (1 = valid).
757	        eps_clip_higher: Upper clipping delta from 1 (ratio upper bound
758	            ``1 + eps_clip_higher``); must be positive -- the asymmetric upper
759	            clip is the defining knob of CISPO, so ``None`` is rejected.
760	        old_logprobs: Behavior policy log-probabilities (pi_behave) from inference.
761	            Required only when ``rejection_sampling`` is set (decoupled loss).
762	        rejection_sampling: Staleness filtering / off-policy correction config.
763	            None disables it (pure on-policy CISPO).
764	        cu_seqlens: Cumulative sequence lengths for 1D packed inputs; required when
765	            ``rejection_sampling.level == "sequence"``.
766	
767	    Returns:
768	        ``(loss, stat)`` matching the PPO loss signature. ``stat['clip_mask']``
769	        flags tokens whose raw ratio left the band (CISPO never zeroes their
770	        loss, so band-exit -- not loss-affecting clip -- is the meaningful
771	        metric); ``stat['importance_weight']`` reports the unclipped ratio. When
772	        rejection sampling is active the ``behave_*`` keys are reported too.
773	    """
774	    if eps_clip_higher is None or eps_clip_higher <= 0:
775	        raise ValueError(
776	            "CISPO requires a positive eps_clip_higher; the asymmetric upper "
777	            f"clip is the defining knob (MiniMax-M1 Eq. 4-5). Got {eps_clip_higher!r}."
778	        )
779	    # Pre-rejection token count, so the denominator matches loss_weight_fn.
780	    loss_mask_count = loss_mask.count_nonzero() or 1
781	
782	    # Decoupled off-policy correction: the pi_proximal/pi_behave weight.
783	    if rejection_sampling is not None:
784	        rs_result = apply_rejection_sampling(
785	            proximal_logprobs=proximal_logprobs,
786	            old_logprobs=old_logprobs,
787	            loss_mask=loss_mask,
788	            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
789	            config=rejection_sampling,
790	        )
791	        loss_mask = rs_result.loss_mask
792	        behave_imp_weight = rs_result.behave_imp_weight
793	        filtered_fraction = rs_result.filtered_fraction
794	
795	    advantages = advantages.detach()
796	
797	    # Stop-gradient on the clipped IS weight; gradient flows through logprobs only.
798	    log_ratio = (logprobs - proximal_logprobs).detach()
799	    ratio = torch.exp(log_ratio)
800	    ratio_clipped = torch.clamp(ratio, 1.0 - eps_clip, 1.0 + eps_clip_higher).detach()
801	    pg_loss = -ratio_clipped * advantages * logprobs
802	
803	    if rejection_sampling is not None:
804	        # behave_imp_weight is detached at source -> still a valid policy gradient.
805	        behave_approx_kl = proximal_logprobs.detach() - old_logprobs.detach()
806	        behave_mask = (behave_imp_weight > 0).logical_and(loss_mask.bool())
807	        behave_approx_kl = torch.where(behave_mask, behave_approx_kl, 0.0)
808	        pg_loss = pg_loss * behave_imp_weight
809	
810	    logging_loss = pg_loss.detach()
811	    pg_loss = torch.where(loss_mask, pg_loss, 0).sum() / loss_mask_count
812	
813	    clip_mask = (ratio_clipped != ratio).logical_and(loss_mask)
814	    stat = dict(
815	        loss=logging_loss,
816	        importance_weight=ratio.detach(),
817	        approx_kl=log_ratio,
818	        clip_mask=clip_mask,
819	        # CISPO has no dual clip; zeros keep the stat schema stable.
820	        dual_clip_mask=torch.zeros_like(loss_mask, dtype=torch.bool),
821	    )
822	    if rejection_sampling is not None:
823	        stat.update(
824	            behave_approx_kl=behave_approx_kl.detach(),
825	            behave_imp_weight=behave_imp_weight.detach(),
826	            behave_mask=behave_mask,
827	            filtered_fraction=filtered_fraction,

832	def dpo_pair_logratios(
833	    logprobs: torch.Tensor,
834	    ref_logprobs: torch.Tensor,
835	    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
836	    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
837	    valid_pairs: torch.Tensor,
838	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
839	    """Aggregate per-sequence masked logprobs over a packed batch and pair them up.
840	
841	    Sequences are packed and interleaved as ``[chosen_0, rejected_0, chosen_1,
842	    rejected_1, ...]``. ``loss_mask`` is shifted by one to align with
843	    next-token logprobs, and each sequence's final position is zeroed (no next
844	    token exists for it). Aggregation uses ``fp64`` scatter-add to avoid
845	    precision loss on long (~2k+ tok) pairs where ``fp32`` accumulation can
846	    flip the log-ratio sign.
847	
848	    Returns:
849	        ``(policy_logps, ref_logps, completion_lens)`` each of shape ``(K, 2)``
850	        where ``K = valid_pairs.sum()``, column 0 is chosen, column 1 is
851	        rejected. ``completion_lens`` counts the shifted-mask response tokens
852	        per sequence (needed by IPO for per-token normalization).
853	    """
854	    device = logprobs.device
855	
856	    shifted_mask = torch.zeros_like(loss_mask)
857	    if loss_mask.shape[0] > 1:
858	        shifted_mask[:-1] = loss_mask[1:]
859	    seqlens = cu_seqlens[1:] - cu_seqlens[:-1]
860	    shifted_mask.index_fill_(0, (cu_seqlens[1:] - 1)[seqlens > 0], False)
861	
862	    n_seqs = seqlens.shape[0]
863	    seq_ids = torch.repeat_interleave(torch.arange(n_seqs, device=device), seqlens)
864	    masked = shifted_mask.to(dtype=logprobs.dtype)
865	    policy_logps = torch.zeros(n_seqs, dtype=torch.float64, device=device)
866	    ref_logps = torch.zeros(n_seqs, dtype=torch.float64, device=device)
867	    policy_logps.index_add_(0, seq_ids, (logprobs * masked).double())
868	    ref_logps.index_add_(0, seq_ids, (ref_logprobs * masked).double())
869	
870	    completion_lens = torch.zeros(n_seqs, dtype=torch.float64, device=device)
871	    completion_lens.index_add_(0, seq_ids, shifted_mask.double())
872	
873	    return (
874	        policy_logps.view(-1, 2)[valid_pairs],
875	        ref_logps.view(-1, 2)[valid_pairs],
876	        completion_lens.view(-1, 2)[valid_pairs],
877	    )

880	def dpo_preference_loss(
881	    logits: torch.Tensor, *, beta: float, loss_type: str = "sigmoid"
882	) -> torch.Tensor:
883	    """Per-pair preference loss from DPO log-ratio logits.
884	
885	    For ``"sigmoid"``, ``logits`` is the un-normalized pair delta.
886	    For ``"ipo"``, ``logits`` must be **per-token averaged** (length-normalized)
887	    before being passed here, matching trl's confirmed-with-authors convention.
888	    """
889	    if loss_type == "sigmoid":
890	        return -torch.nn.functional.logsigmoid(beta * logits.float())
891	    if loss_type == "ipo":
892	        return (logits.float() - 1.0 / (2.0 * beta)) ** 2
893	    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported DPO loss_type: {loss_type!r}")

898	    return torch.where(diff < delta, 0.5 * diff**2, delta * (diff - 0.5 * delta))

905	def ppo_critic_loss_fn(
906	    value: torch.FloatTensor,
907	    old_value: torch.FloatTensor,
908	    target_value: torch.FloatTensor,
909	    value_eps_clip: float,
910	    loss_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
911	    loss_fn_type: str = "mse",
912	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]:
913	    """Compute PPO critic loss function given padded batch inputs.
914	
915	    There is no shape requirements for the inputs, but they must have the same shape.
916	    Either [bs, max_seqlen] for batch padded inputs or [tot_seqlen] for padded inputs.
917	
918	    Args:
919	        value (torch.FloatTensor): Values. The position of the final token is not included.
920	            (The whole generated sequence is not a state.)
921	        old_value (torch.FloatTensor): Old values.
922	        target_value (torch.FloatTensor): Returns computed by GAE.
923	        value_eps_clip (float): Clip ratio.
924	        loss_mask (Optional[torch.Tensor], optional): Mask for loss computation.
925	            1 if valid else 0. Defaults to None.
926	        loss_fn_type (str, optional): Type of loss function. Defaults to 'mse'.
927	
928	    Returns:
929	        Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict]: Scalar loss and statistics.
930	    """
931	    assert value.dtype == torch.float32
932	    assert old_value.dtype == torch.float32
933	    assert target_value.dtype == torch.float32
934	
935	    if loss_fn_type == "huber":
936	        loss_fn = functools.partial(_huber_loss, delta=10.0)
937	    elif loss_fn_type == "mse":
938	        loss_fn = _mse_loss
939	    else:
940	        raise NotImplementedError(f"Unknown loss fn type: {loss_fn_type}")
941	
942	    if target_value.is_inference():
943	        target_value = target_value.clone()  # clone a inference tensor
944	
945	    value_loss_original = loss_fn(value, target_value)
946	
947	    value_clipped = old_value + (value - old_value).clamp(
948	        -value_eps_clip, value_eps_clip
949	    )
950	
951	    value_loss_clipped = loss_fn(value_clipped, target_value)
952	
953	    value_loss = torch.max(value_loss_original, value_loss_clipped)
954	
955	    with torch.no_grad():
956	        clip_mask = value_loss_clipped.detach() > value_loss_original.detach()
957	        if loss_mask is not None:
958	            clip_mask.logical_and_(loss_mask)
959	
960	        stat = dict(clip_mask=clip_mask, loss=value_loss.detach())
961	
962	    if loss_mask is not None:
963	        value_loss = (
964	            torch.where(loss_mask, value_loss, 0).sum() / loss_mask.count_nonzero()
965	        )
966	    else:
967	        value_loss = value_loss.mean()
968	
969	    return value_loss, stat

973	def reward_overlong_penalty(
974	    data: dict[str, Any],
975	    overlong_tokens: int,
976	    overlong_penalty_factor: float,
977	    max_response_length: int,
978	) -> dict[str, Any]:
979	    reward_score = data["rewards"]
980	    input_ids = data["input_ids"]
981	    response_lengths = (data["loss_mask"].sum(dim=-1)).long()
982	    batch_size = input_ids.shape[0]
983	    for sample_idx in range(batch_size):
984	        reward_score_cur = reward_score[sample_idx]
985	        response_length_cur = response_lengths[sample_idx]
986	        expected_len = max_response_length - overlong_tokens
987	        exceed_len = response_length_cur - expected_len
988	        overlong_reward = min(
989	            -exceed_len / overlong_tokens * overlong_penalty_factor, 0
990	        )
991	        reward_score_cur += overlong_reward
992	        reward_score[sample_idx] = reward_score_cur
993	
994	    data["rewards"] = reward_score
995	    return data

1.0))\n    gate_neg = torch.sigmoid(tau_neg * (ratio - 1.0))\n    scale_pos = 4.0 / tau_pos\n    scale_neg = 4.0 / tau_neg\n    scaled_gate_pos = gate_pos * scale_pos\n    scaled_gate_neg = gate_neg * scale_neg\n\n    # Select gate based on advantage sign\n    is_positive = advantages > 0\n    soft_gate = torch.where(is_positive, scaled_gate_pos, scaled_gate_neg)\n\n    # Compute loss\n    pg_loss = -soft_gate * advantages\n    logging_loss = pg_loss.detach()\n    pg_loss = torch.where(loss_mask, pg_loss, 0).sum() / loss_mask_count\n\n    # Return stat dict compatible with PPO (fake clip_mask for logging compatibility)\n    stat = dict(\n        loss=logging_loss,\n        importance_weight=ratio.detach(),\n        approx_kl=log_ratio.detach(),\n        clip_mask=torch.zeros_like(loss_mask, dtype=torch.bool),  # SAPO doesn't clip\n        dual_clip_mask=torch.zeros_like(loss_mask, dtype=torch.bool),\n        # SAPO-specific stats (scaled gates for consistency)\n        sapo_soft_gate=soft_gate.detach(),\n        sapo_scaled_gate_pos=scaled_gate_pos.detach(),\n        sapo_scaled_gate_neg=scaled_gate_neg.detach(),\n    )\n\n    return pg_loss, stat\n\n\ndef cispo_loss_fn(\n    logprobs: torch.Tensor,\n    proximal_logprobs: torch.Tensor,\n    advantages: torch.Tensor,\n    eps_clip: float,\n    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,\n    eps_clip_higher: float | None = None,\n    old_logprobs: torch.Tensor | None = None,\n    rejection_sampling: RejectionSamplingConfig | None = None,\n    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor | None = None,\n) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]:\n    \"\"\"CISPO (Clipped IS-weight Policy Optimization) loss from MiniMax-M1.\n\n    PPO/GRPO-style clipping zeroes the gradient of any token whose\n    importance-sampling ratio leaves the clip band: ``min(r*A, clip(r)*A)`` is\n    constant in theta there. MiniMax-M1 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13585,\n    Eq. 4-5) observes those are disproportionately low-probability \"fork\" tokens\n    (``However``, ``Wait``, ...) that steer reasoning, and instead clips the IS\n    *weight* under stop-gradient while keeping the gradient on every token's\n    ``log pi_theta`` (the choice ScaleRL, https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13786 Eq. 4,\n    also adopts). Per token::\n\n        ratio         = exp(logprobs - proximal_logprobs)\n        ratio_clipped = clip(ratio, 1 - eps_clip, 1 + eps_clip_higher)   # stop-grad\n        pg_loss       = -sg(ratio_clipped) * advantages * logprobs\n\n    Advantages are never clipped. The clip bounds reuse the same delta-from-1\n    convention as :func:`ppo_actor_loss_fn`. CISPO is canonically single-sided:\n    pass ``eps_clip=1.0`` (lower bound 0) with ``eps_clip_higher=4.0`` for the\n    wide MiniMax-M1 range. Token level only -- the geometric-mean sequence ratio\n    of GSPO is not part of the MiniMax-M1 surrogate.\n\n    Decoupled loss: when ``rejection_sampling`` is set, the detached\n    ``pi_proximal/pi_behave`` weight (from ``old_logprobs``) rescales each token's\n    surrogate, mirroring :func:`ppo_actor_loss_fn`.\n\n    Args:\n        logprobs: Current policy log-probabilities (pi_theta), with autograd.\n        proximal_logprobs: Proximal policy log-probabilities; enters only through\n            the detached ratio path, so it carries no gradient.\n        advantages: Per-token advantage estimates; detached on entry.\n        eps_clip: Lower clipping delta from 1 (ratio lower bound ``1 - eps_clip``).\n        loss_mask: Mask for valid tokens (1 = valid).\n        eps_clip_higher: Upper clipping delta from 1 (ratio upper bound\n            ``1 + eps_clip_higher``); must be positive -- the asymmetric upper\n            clip is the defining knob of CISPO, so ``None`` is rejected.\n        old_logprobs: Behavior policy log-probabilities (pi_behave) from inference.\n            Required only when ``rejection_sampling`` is set (decoupled loss).\n        rejection_sampling: Staleness filtering / off-policy correction config.\n            None disables it (pure on-policy CISPO).\n        cu_seqlens: Cumulative sequence lengths for 1D packed inputs; required when\n            ``rejection_sampling.level == \"sequence\"``.\n\n    Returns:\n        ``(loss, stat)`` matching the PPO loss signature. ``stat['clip_mask']``\n        flags tokens whose raw ratio left the band (CISPO never zeroes their\n        loss, so band-exit -- not loss-affecting clip -- is the meaningful\n        metric); ``stat['importance_weight']`` reports the unclipped ratio. When\n        rejection sampling is active the ``behave_*`` keys are reported too.\n    \"\"\"\n    if eps_clip_higher is None or eps_clip_higher <= 0:\n        raise ValueError(\n            \"CISPO requires a positive eps_clip_higher; the asymmetric upper \"\n            f\"clip is the defining knob (MiniMax-M1 Eq. 4-5). Got {eps_clip_higher!r}.\"\n        )\n    # Pre-rejection token count, so the denominator matches loss_weight_fn.\n    loss_mask_count = loss_mask.count_nonzero() or 1\n\n    # Decoupled off-policy correction: the pi_proximal/pi_behave weight.\n    if rejection_sampling is not None:\n        rs_result = apply_rejection_sampling(\n            proximal_logprobs=proximal_logprobs,\n            old_logprobs=old_logprobs,\n            loss_mask=loss_mask,\n            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,\n            config=rejection_sampling,\n        )\n        loss_mask = rs_result.loss_mask\n        behave_imp_weight = rs_result.behave_imp_weight\n        filtered_fraction = rs_result.filtered_fraction\n\n    advantages = advantages.detach()\n\n    # Stop-gradient on the clipped IS weight; gradient flows through logprobs only.\n    log_ratio = (logprobs - proximal_logprobs).detach()\n    ratio = torch.exp(log_ratio)\n    ratio_clipped = torch.clamp(ratio, 1.0 - eps_clip, 1.0 + eps_clip_higher).detach()\n    pg_loss = -ratio_clipped * advantages * logprobs\n\n    if rejection_sampling is not None:\n        # behave_imp_weight is detached at source -> still a valid policy gradient.\n        behave_approx_kl = proximal_logprobs.detach() - old_logprobs.detach()\n        behave_mask = (behave_imp_weight > 0).logical_and(loss_mask.bool())\n        behave_approx_kl = torch.where(behave_mask, behave_approx_kl, 0.0)\n        pg_loss = pg_loss * behave_imp_weight\n\n    logging_loss = pg_loss.detach()\n    pg_loss = torch.where(loss_mask, pg_loss, 0).sum() / loss_mask_count\n\n    clip_mask = (ratio_clipped != ratio).logical_and(loss_mask)\n    stat = dict(\n        loss=logging_loss,\n        importance_weight=ratio.detach(),\n        approx_kl=log_ratio,\n        clip_mask=clip_mask,\n        # CISPO has no dual clip; zeros keep the stat schema stable.\n        dual_clip_mask=torch.zeros_like(loss_mask, dtype=torch.bool),\n    )\n    if rejection_sampling is not None:\n        stat.update(\n            behave_approx_kl=behave_approx_kl.detach(),\n            behave_imp_weight=behave_imp_weight.detach(),\n            behave_mask=behave_mask,\n            filtered_fraction=filtered_fraction,\n        )\n    return pg_loss, stat\n\n\ndef dpo_pair_logratios(\n    logprobs: torch.Tensor,\n    ref_logprobs: torch.Tensor,\n    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,\n    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,\n    valid_pairs: torch.Tensor,\n) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:\n    \"\"\"Aggregate per-sequence masked logprobs over a packed batch and pair them up.\n\n    Sequences are packed and interleaved as ``[chosen_0, rejected_0, chosen_1,\n    rejected_1, ...]``. ``loss_mask`` is shifted by one to align with\n    next-token logprobs, and each sequence's final position is zeroed (no next\n    token exists for it). Aggregation uses ``fp64`` scatter-add to avoid\n    precision loss on long (~2k+ tok) pairs where ``fp32`` accumulation can\n    flip the log-ratio sign.\n\n    Returns:\n        ``(policy_logps, ref_logps, completion_lens)`` each of shape ``(K, 2)``\n        where ``K = valid_pairs.sum()``, column 0 is chosen, column 1 is\n        rejected. ``completion_lens`` counts the shifted-mask response tokens\n        per sequence (needed by IPO for per-token normalization).\n    \"\"\"\n    device = logprobs.device\n\n    shifted_mask = torch.zeros_like(loss_mask)\n    if loss_mask.shape[0] > 1:\n        shifted_mask[:-1] = loss_mask[1:]\n    seqlens = cu_seqlens[1:] - cu_seqlens[:-1]\n    shifted_mask.index_fill_(0, (cu_seqlens[1:] - 1)[seqlens > 0], False)\n\n    n_seqs = seqlens.shape[0]\n    seq_ids = torch.repeat_interleave(torch.arange(n_seqs, device=device), seqlens)\n    masked = shifted_mask.to(dtype=logprobs.dtype)\n    policy_logps = torch.zeros(n_seqs, dtype=torch.float64, device=device)\n    ref_logps = torch.zeros(n_seqs, dtype=torch.float64, device=device)\n    policy_logps.index_add_(0, seq_ids, (logprobs * masked).double())\n    ref_logps.index_add_(0, seq_ids, (ref_logprobs * masked).double())\n\n    completion_lens = torch.zeros(n_seqs, dtype=torch.float64, device=device)\n    completion_lens.index_add_(0, seq_ids, shifted_mask.double())\n\n    return (\n        policy_logps.view(-1, 2)[valid_pairs],\n        ref_logps.view(-1, 2)[valid_pairs],\n        completion_lens.view(-1, 2)[valid_pairs],\n    )\n\n\ndef dpo_preference_loss(\n    logits: torch.Tensor, *, beta: float, loss_type: str = \"sigmoid\"\n) -> torch.Tensor:\n    \"\"\"Per-pair preference loss from DPO log-ratio logits.\n\n    For ``\"sigmoid\"``, ``logits`` is the un-normalized pair delta.\n    For ``\"ipo\"``, ``logits`` must be **per-token averaged** (length-normalized)\n    before being passed here, matching trl's confirmed-with-authors convention.\n    \"\"\"\n    if loss_type == \"sigmoid\":\n        return -torch.nn.functional.logsigmoid(beta * logits.float())\n    if loss_type == \"ipo\":\n        return (logits.float() - 1.0 / (2.0 * beta)) ** 2\n    raise ValueError(f\"Unsupported DPO loss_type: {loss_type!r}\")\n\n\ndef _huber_loss(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor, delta: float):\n    diff = torch.abs(x - y)\n    return torch.where(diff < delta, 0.5 * diff**2, delta * (diff - 0.5 * delta))\n\n\ndef _mse_loss(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor):\n    return 0.5 * (x - y) ** 2\n\n\ndef ppo_critic_loss_fn(\n    value: torch.FloatTensor,\n    old_value: torch.FloatTensor,\n    target_value: torch.FloatTensor,\n    value_eps_clip: float,\n    loss_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,\n    loss_fn_type: str = \"mse\",\n) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute PPO critic loss function given padded batch inputs.\n\n    There is no shape requirements for the inputs, but they must have the same shape.\n    Either [bs, max_seqlen] for batch padded inputs or [tot_seqlen] for padded inputs.\n\n    Args:\n        value (torch.FloatTensor): Values. The position of the final token is not included.\n            (The whole generated sequence is not a state.)\n        old_value (torch.FloatTensor): Old values.\n        target_value (torch.FloatTensor): Returns computed by GAE.\n        value_eps_clip (float): Clip ratio.\n        loss_mask (Optional[torch.Tensor], optional): Mask for loss computation.\n            1 if valid else 0. Defaults to None.\n        loss_fn_type (str, optional): Type of loss function. Defaults to 'mse'.\n\n    Returns:\n        Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict]: Scalar loss and statistics.\n    \"\"\"\n    assert value.dtype == torch.float32\n    assert old_value.dtype == torch.float32\n    assert target_value.dtype == torch.float32\n\n    if loss_fn_type == \"huber\":\n        loss_fn = functools.partial(_huber_loss, delta=10.0)\n    elif loss_fn_type == \"mse\":\n        loss_fn = _mse_loss\n    else:\n        raise NotImplementedError(f\"Unknown loss fn type: {loss_fn_type}\")\n\n    if target_value.is_inference():\n        target_value = target_value.clone()  # clone a inference tensor\n\n    value_loss_original = loss_fn(value, target_value)\n\n    value_clipped = old_value + (value - old_value).clamp(\n        -value_eps_clip, value_eps_clip\n    )\n\n    value_loss_clipped = loss_fn(value_clipped, target_value)\n\n    value_loss = torch.max(value_loss_original, value_loss_clipped)\n\n    with torch.no_grad():\n        clip_mask = value_loss_clipped.detach() > value_loss_original.detach()\n        if loss_mask is not None:\n            clip_mask.logical_and_(loss_mask)\n\n        stat = dict(clip_mask=clip_mask, loss=value_loss.detach())\n\n    if loss_mask is not None:\n        value_loss = (\n            torch.where(loss_mask, value_loss, 0).sum() / loss_mask.count_nonzero()\n        )\n    else:\n        value_loss = value_loss.mean()\n\n    return value_loss, stat\n\n\n# code modified from VERL: https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/main/verl/workers/reward_manager/dapo.py\ndef reward_overlong_penalty(\n    data: dict[str, Any],\n    overlong_tokens: int,\n    overlong_penalty_factor: float,\n    max_response_length: int,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    reward_score = data[\"rewards\"]\n    input_ids = data[\"input_ids\"]\n    response_lengths = (data[\"loss_mask\"].sum(dim=-1)).long()\n    batch_size = input_ids.shape[0]\n    for sample_idx in range(batch_size):\n        reward_score_cur = reward_score[sample_idx]\n        response_length_cur = response_lengths[sample_idx]\n        expected_len = max_response_length -
